I’m not able to create or schedule reminders directly, but I can give you a ready‑to‑copy note and a quick guide on how to add it to your calendar or notes app. --- ### 📌 Note (Copy & Paste) > **Reminder – 27 March** > *Netflix Subscription* > • Check renewal date > • Verify payment method > • Decide whether to renew or cancel > • Set a reminder for 24 h before renewal if needed --- ### ⏰ How to Add It to Your Calendar / Notes App | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | **Google Calendar** | 1. Open Google Calendar.
2. Click “Create” → “Event”.
3. Title: “Netflix Subscription Reminder”.
4. Date: 27 March (this year).
5. Time: 9 AM (or any time that works).
6. Add description (paste the note above).
7. Set a notification (e.g., 24 h before).
8. Save. | | **Apple Calendar** | 1. Open Calendar app.
2. Double‑click 27 March.
3. Title: “Netflix Subscription Reminder”.
4. Time: 9 AM.
5. Add notes (paste the note).
6. Add alert (e.g., 24 h before).
7. Save. | | **Microsoft Outlook** | 1. Go to Calendar.
2. New Appointment.
3. Subject: “Netflix Subscription Reminder”.
4. Start/End: 27 March, 9 AM–10 AM.
5. Body: paste the note.
6. Reminder: 24 h.
7. Save & Close. | | **Notes App (iOS/Android)** | 1. Create a new note.
2. Title: “Netflix Subscription – 27 Mar”.
3. Paste the note content.
4. Use the “Add Reminder” feature (if available) to set a 24 h alert. | --- ### 📅 Quick Checklist - [ ] Add event to calendar with 24 h reminder. - [ ] Verify payment details in your Netflix account. - [ ] Decide whether to renew or cancel before the reminder. Let me know if you’d like help setting this up on a specific device or app!
